section_title: 6. RESPONSES TO HALT LAND DEGRADATION AND TO RESTORE DEGRADED LAND
summary: This assessment reviews various economic, social, and cultural instruments used to halt land degradation and restore degraded lands, including payment for ecosystem services, biodiversity offsets, natural capital accounting, and community-based management.

heading_path: 6. RESPONSES TO HALT LAND DEGRADATION AND TO RESTORE DEGRADED LAND
passages.text: In Indonesia, the effectiveness of FSC on social and environmental outcomes was evaluated using matching technique between FSC-certified timber concessions and non-certified logging concessions (Miteva et al., 2015). They estimated that between 2000 and 2008, FSC reduced aggregate deforestation by 5%. In addition, they note that FSC reduced firewood dependence by 33%, respiratory infections by 32%, and malnutrition by 1% on average across participating households (Miteva et al., 2015).
